name: FEUD
description: Li Qingyue, the Four Spirit Immortal, and Bai Jiusi, the powerful Dacheng Lord, are caught in a turbulent love-hate relationship. As hidden truths come to light, they overcome their misunderstandings and join forces to protect the world from impending danger.

videos.title: Losing One's Head
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi first meets Li Qingyue and follows her back to the Jingyun Sect. The next day, Li Qingyue is accidentally placed in confinement.

videos.title: Marrying a Mortal
videos.overview: A date is set for Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi’s wedding. Zhang Suan opens up to Li Qingyue. On her wedding day, Li Qingyue ascends to the Nine Heavens.

videos.title: Wedding Night
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi introduces Li Qingyue to everyone. The next day, she finds herself in danger on her way back — but Bai Jiusi rescues her.

videos.title: Hope
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi has his doubts about Li Qingyue’s identity, and tests her repeatedly. Fan Ling'er is consumed with jealousy toward Li Qingyue.

videos.title: Abnormality
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi investigates the assault on Li Qingyue’s life. Zhang Suan learns of Bai Jiusi’s past. Bai Jiusi tests Li Qingyue again.

videos.title: Sun Fruit
videos.overview: A critically wounded Li Qingyue is on the brink of death — and Bai Jiusi strives to save her. While in seclusion, he recalls his tragic past.

videos.title: The Abyss
videos.overview: Fan Ling'er reveals the truth to Li Qingyue. A jeopardized Li Qingyue enters the Forbidden Ruins, and Bai Jiusi breaks out of seclusion to save her.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi go on a mission to capture Honglian. To save Li Qingyue, Bai Jiusi enters into the illusion where she's trapped.

videos.title: Grave Mistake
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi fiercely resists the ice barrier but is severely injured. At a critical moment, Li Qingyue uses the fire technique to repel Honglian.

videos.title: Four Spirits Grandmistress
videos.overview: Li Qingyue is taken prisoner. When Bai Jiusi questions her, she is ready to harm herself to prove her identity.

videos.title: Activating the Seal
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi hesitates to seal away Li Qingyue. Zhang Suan tries but fails to rescue her. As the sealing begins, Li Qingyue experiences terrible pain.

videos.title: Dying Together
videos.overview: Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi face off as immortals and mortals clash. Li Qingyue recalls their shared past.

videos.title: A Life of Servitude
videos.overview: Hua Ruyue and Bai Jiusi are consumed by the trials of betrayed love. Hua Ruyue interferes with the karma of mortals — and suffers the consequences.

videos.title: Help Meng Changqin
videos.overview: Hua Ruyue casts a spell to save Meng Changqin. A sulking Bai Jiusi goes on a blind date, and Hua Ruyue apologizes to him.

videos.title: Killing the Drought Dragon
videos.overview: Hua Ruyue and Bai Jiusi reconcile. Hua Ruyue helps Meng Changqin slay the dragon but Bai Jiusi seals her spiritual power.

videos.title: 10-Year Deal
videos.overview: Fan Ling'er opens up about her connection to Li Qingyue. Bai Jiusi and Li Qingyue agree to live together as mortals for 10 years.

videos.title: Friends
videos.overview: A stranger's kindness stirs Bai Jiusi’s heart. His relationship with Li Qingyue warms up.

videos.title: Like a Mortal
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi uses his power to save Lin Fan’s son, and suffers the consequences. He investigates the evil spirit, leaving Li Qingyue deeply moved.

videos.title: Barrier
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi and Li Qingyue are caught in the evil spirit's spell. As Li Qingyue takes care of Bai Jiusi, the two suspect a trap.

videos.title: Battle Against the Evil Spirit
videos.overview: Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi discuss their past and present, easing tensions. Li Qingyue battles the evil spirit alone until Bai Jiusi shows up.

videos.title: Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Li Qingyue reveals the reason behind the plot to kill Bai Jiusi. Bai Jiusi’s soul returns, forbidding his disciples from harming Li Qingyue.

videos.title: The Battle of Immortals
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi tries to go back in time to find the truth. Longyuan gathers his forces to start a war between immortals and mortals. Li Qingyue reminisces.

videos.title: The Sad Past
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi enters a time tunnel toward the past. Grief-stricken after losing her child, Hua Ruyue escapes with help from Meng Changqin.

videos.title: The Resurrection Formation
videos.overview: Hua Ruyue's plan is frustrated by Bai Jiusi's intervention. Upon regaining consciousness, Bai Jiusi orders the troops to withdraw.

videos.title: More Than Meets the Eye
videos.overview: Hua Ruyue suspects someone is using her to get to Bai Jiusi. Qingyang is killed. Hua Ruyue goes to the Nine Heavens to seek justice, shocking everyone.

videos.title: Ascend
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi orders the barrier lifted, allowing the members of the Jingyun Sect in. Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi scheme.

videos.title: The Real Objective
videos.overview: Bai Jiusi, Hua Ruyue and Xiao Jingshan face off. Bai Jiusi awakens in the Ninth Heaven with a transformed temperament.

videos.title: Memory Loss
videos.overview: Great Wilderness Stele is restored, deceiving Hua Ruyue and Bai Jiusi. As the Hell Ruins seal weakens, Hua Ruyue directs everyone to split up.

videos.title: Entering the Illusory Realm
videos.overview: Souls are being stolen — Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi investigate. Xiao Jingshan incites the people to attack them.

videos.title: False Happiness
videos.overview: Li Qingyue sets up a barrier for protection and discusses next steps. Li Qingyue and Bai Jiusi get stuck in the Yin-Yang formation.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: A severely injured Bai Jiusi decides to sacrifice himself. Li Qingyue combines the power of two swords to defeat Xiao Jingshan.

videos.title: Changing the Past
videos.overview: Li Qingyue travels through time in an effort to eliminate regrets, and ends up embarking on a journey to find Bai Jiusi.
